answer: Give each identity a glacier-slow proving season: on joining it must plant public, timestamped forecasts about assigned, identity-specific questions — will this juniper plot outyield that one, will a named market move — and standing unlocks only months later, when those forecasts resolve. A mirror earns nothing: copying another identity's forecast splits the credit and mismatches its assigned questions, while running many clones means maintaining many distinct, checkable prediction tracks in the open, each falsifiable, none retroactively editable.
